senses.gloss:
ली ली (the original signification is ‘To be viscous,’ then ‘To be solvable’), i. 1 and 10, Par. To melt, to liquefy, to dissolve. ii. 9. लिना, लिनी, Par.
 1. [] To adhere.
 2. To obtain.
 --i. 4, Ātm. (properly pass.),
 1. To be dissolved, to vanish, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 450.
 2. To adhere or cling to.
 3. To dwell, to live, to haunt, MBh. 1, 4310.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लीन.
 1. Melted, dissolved, Vedāntas. in Chr. 219, 12.
 2. Effaced, wiped away, removed, Kir. 5, 26.
 3. Left.
 4. Embraced.
 5. Staying, Pañc. 187, 5; being situated, resting, Śāk. d. 144.
 6. Entered, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 830.
 --With the prep. अन्तर् अन्तर्, अन्तर्लीन, Inherent, staying; haunting in the interior, Pañc. 109, 19; i. d. 420; Utt. Rāmac. 56, 10; (not coming out), Pañc. 175, 24. Acc. sing. ˚नम्, adv. Inwardly, Pañc. 185, 3.
 --With अप अप, Caus. लापय, Ātm. To deceive, Bhaṭṭ. 8, 44.
 --With अभि अभि, अभिलीन, Adhering, Megh. 37.
 --With अव अव, To cling to, Nal. 2, 46.
 --With समव सम्-अव, i. 4, To be dissolved, Vedāntas. in Chr. 219, 15.
 --With आ आ, i. 4, To faint, MBh. 3, 2573.
 --With नि नि, i. 4,
 1. To alight, to settle, MBh. 3, 10560.
 2. To lie down, MBh. 3, 12091.
 3. To hide one's self, MBh. 3, 10978. निलीन,
 1. Fused in or into.
 2. Transformed.
 3. Destroyed.
 4. Encompassed.
 5. Full.
 --With संनि सम्-नि, i. 4, To lie down, MBh. 3, 13654.
 --With प्र प्र, i. 4,
 1. To be dissolved or absorbed, Man. 1, 54.
 2. To die, Man. 4, 240.
 3. To unite intimately, Man. 12, 17. प्रलीन,
 1. Destroyed.
 2. Unconscious, insensible.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, pass. To be destroyed, Hit. iii. d. 129.
 --With वि वि, i. 4,
 1. To alight, Śiś. 1, 12.
 2. To be dissolved, to vanish, Pañc. ii. d. 98; to become ineffectual, iii. d. 74. विलिन,
 1. Liquefied, [] melted.
 2. Dissolved, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 830; Lass. 11, 15.
 3. Disappeared.
 4. Imagined.
 5. United.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. वि-लायय, -लापय, -ली̆नय (properly a denomin. derived from विलीन), लालय (also a denomin. from लाला with वि), To dissolve. विलायित, Dissolved, Prab. 116, 8.
 --With प्रवि प्र-वि, i. 4, To be dissolved, to vanish, Bhag. 4, 23.
 --With सम् सम्, संलीन,
 1. Joined, put together, Pañc. 163, 6.
 2. Staying, MBh. 1, 7671.
 --Cf. Lat. līmus (borrowed O.H.G. lim; A.S. líme, and O.H.G. leim; A.S. lám), po-lîre, linere; λεῖμαξ.
